blocks.text: The installer maintains nftables rules and application-specific network isolation. Computer Management provides Protection & Firewall. A normal application, a VPN and a managed browser namespace may follow different policies.

Use the existing managed firewall views and profile controls. Do not combine independent rule managers or edit generated tables while another writer owns them. Local repository signing, content hashes and vendor signatures establish different trust claims.

Identify the exact application, destination type and operation. Compare ordinary connectivity with that application's intended isolation. Review sanitized status and the profile-selected services with an administrator.
Flushing the ruleset, opening broad inbound ranges, or replacing routes can break unrelated services and leak traffic. Recovery must restore only policy owned by the responsible tool.
